newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-GALAXY CLAIM CONCACAF CHAMPIONS' CUP BERTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GALAXY CLAIM CONCACAF CHAMPIONS' CUP BERTH.

text.p: Major League Soccer's Los Angeles Galaxy erupted for four second-half goals Wednesday to defeat Santos Laguna AC of Mexico 4-1 and earn a place in the CONCACAF Champions' Cup tournament.

The victory earned the Galaxy a meeting with Luis Angel Firpo of El Salvador August 13 in Washington in the tournament that features winners and runnersup from first-division leagues in North America, Central America and the Caribbean.
The Galaxy finished second to DC United in 1996 MLS Cup, the U.S. premier league's championship match.
Los Angeles scored two goals within one minute to take a 2-0 lead in the second half.

Mauricio Cienfuegos, a member of El Salvador's national team, took a right-wing cross from Cobi Jones and kicked an 11-meter shot into the upper-right corner of the Mexican club's goal in the 64th minute.
One minute later, Eduardo Hurtado doubled the score.

Hurtado, a member of Ecuador's national team, took a long ball from Guillermo Jara, kicked a high shot from 15 meters while marked tightly by defender Joaquin Velasquez and hit the underside of the top of the net.

Santos cut the deficit to one in the in the 70th minute on a low, hard shot from 30 meters by Nicolas Ramirez, who plays on Mexico's national team. But the Galaxy added two more goals to secure its victory.
In the 80th minute, Martin Machon converted a back-heel pass from Cienfuegos into a 16-meter line drive. Then in the 84th minute, Welton scored on a low shot from 19 meters.

Galaxy goalkeeper Jorge Campos made three saves as his defence held Santos to five shots on goal, three in the second half. Meanwhile, Los Angeles took eight shots on goal, with Miguel making four saves.

Los Angeles Galaxy: Jorge Campos; Danny Pena, Robin Fraser, Paul Caligiuri, Greg Vanney; Martin Machon, Guillermo Jara ( Gerardo Laterza, 85), Mauricio Cienfuegos, Harut Karapetyan ( Welton, 76), Cobi Jones; Eduardo Hurtado.

Santos Laguna: Jose Miguel; Enrique Vizcarra (Pedro Duana, 72), Miguel Espana (Miguel Asprilla, 81), Nicolas Ramirez, Jorge Rodriguez, Joaquin Velasquez; Francisco DeAnda, Bulmaro Gonzalez, Jared Borguetti; Gabriel Caballero, Sergio Verdirame (Saul Quinonez, 86).
